goal: Prove (and, only if a real gap surfaces, fix) whole-dungeon completion: killing the last hostile anywhere in an N-region InitDungeon encounter ends the encounter in victory (canonical EncounterEndedReasonAllHostilesDefeated), clearing a non-final combat pocket exits non-terminally to FREE_ROAM, TPK ends with the canonical EncounterEndedReasonTPK, and the resulting ModeEnded/terminal state is reload-safe via ToData/LoadFromData to the extent the toolkit persists it (Reason itself is an event-only field, not persisted -- rpg-api/#690 owns any reason projection).

sessions.task: TDD: write the N-region multi-pocket completion + TPK + reload-safety tests against InitDungeon (RED/GREEN outcome recorded per test)
sessions.notes: New file, package encounter_test. Reuses dungeon_test.go's shared row/region helpers and constants (dungeonHeight, dungeonEntranceWidth/CorridorWidth/BossWidth, dungeonRegionID*, dungeonDoor0ID/1ID, dungeonRegionNearEdgeHex/FarEdgeHex) -- all-PatternEmpty regions (own params fn, not threeRegionDungeonParams) for deterministic LoS/movement, isolating the encounter-lifecycle behavior under test from wall-generation randomness (already covered by dungeon_test.go itself). TestClearingEarlyPockets_ThenVictoryOnLastHostile_ReloadSafe: entrance goblin (pocket 1) cleared -> FREE_ROAM, corridor+boss goblins still alive; open door0+move, corridor goblin (pocket 2) cleared -> FREE_ROAM again, boss still alive and still hidden behind closed door1; open door1+move, boss goblin (last hostile anywhere) killed -> ModeEnded, EncounterEndedReasonAllHostilesDefeated. Then ToData->JSON->LoadFromData round trip; asserts Mode stays ModeEnded and Initiative stays empty post-reload, and a post-reload TakeAction call returns ErrEncounterEnded (not an inescapable fight). TestTPKMidDungeon_EndsWithCanonicalReason_HostilesRemainElsewhere: same dungeon shape, solo flat-snapshot alice (HP 1, no DataJSON) engages only the entrance goblin; EndTurn-cycled to the goblin's turn, NPCAct kills alice -> allPlayersDead() -> ModeEnded, EncounterEndedReasonTPK, with corridor+boss goblins asserted STILL alive and untouched (proving TPK doesn't require/trigger any hostile-clearing, and doesn't fire the victory reason). Same reload-safety round trip appended. RESULT: both tests passed on the FIRST run, no production code changed -- see tests.json for the explicit RED-would-have-looked-like note per test and the discrimination performed to rule out a vacuously-passing test.

sessions.task: Discrimination: prove the new tests are not vacuous (would fail if the rule were actually broken)
sessions.notes: Per verification-before-completion discipline, three separate mutations, each reverted from a /tmp/opencode backup copy immediately after its rerun (confirmed byte-identical to origin/main via `git diff origin/main -- death.go combat.go` after every revert): (1) death.go's victory case guard `case len(e.data.Monsters) == 0:` -> `case false && len(e.data.Monsters) == 0:` -- TestClearingEarlyPockets_ThenVictoryOnLastHostile_ReloadSafe correctly FAILED (Mode never reached ModeEnded after the boss died; expected 3 Monsters removed, got 1; EncounterEndedEvent absent). Reverted, reran -- GREEN. (2) combat.go's checkPocketCleared -- inserted `return nil` as its first line (short-circuiting the whole function) -- same test correctly FAILED at the very first pocket-clear assertion (Mode stayed ModeTurnBased, Initiative non-empty, ModeChangedEvent absent). Reverted, GREEN. (3) death.go's TPK case guard `case e.allPlayersDead():` -> `case false && e.allPlayersDead():` -- TestTPKMidDungeon_EndsWithCanonicalReason_HostilesRemainElsewhere correctly FAILED (Mode never left ModeTurnBased/ModeFreeRoam after alice's death; EncounterEndedEvent absent). Reverted, GREEN. Confirms all new assertions exercise real, breakable behavior rather than passing vacuously.
